title: Interrogātiōnēs Oblīquae
subtitle: Quaestiōnēs indirēctae: rēgula sequentiae applicāta (indicātīvus/coniūnctīvus retentus vs. optātīvus oblīquus); εἰ prō quaestiōnibus sī/nōn; ὅστις ut interrogātīvum oblīquum.
objectives: Cōnstruere interrogātiōnem oblīquam applicandō rēgulam sequentiae (Gradū V): modus retentus sequentiā prīmāriā, optātīvus oblīquus sequentiā secundāriā
Adhibēre εἰ prō quaestiōnibus indirēctīs "sī/num" (quaestiōnēs sine verbō interrogātīvō explicitō)
Recognōscere ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅτι (compositum ex ὅς + τις) ut prōnōmen interrogātīvum oblīquum frequēns, alternātīvum τίς
Distinguere quaestiōnem dīrēctam (cum τίς; signum ;) ā quaestiōne indirēctā (sine ; propriō, intrā clausulam maiōrem)

content.intro: Interrogātiō oblīqua ("rogāvī QUIS vēnisset", nōn quaestiō dīrēcta "quis vēnit?") sequitur rēgulam sequentiae iam plēnē nōtam (Gradū V): post verbum rogandī PRĪMĀRIUM, modus quaestiōnis dīrēctae originālis plērumque RETINĒTUR; post verbum rogandī SECUNDĀRIUM, MODUS FIT OPTĀTĪVUS ("optātīvus oblīquus") — patrōnus IDENTICUS illī iam vīsō in clausulīs fīnālibus.
content.explanation: Duo genera interrogātiōnum oblīquārum: (1) cum verbō interrogātīvō (τίς, ποῦ, πῶς, quae iam nōta ex Gradū II), et (2) sine verbō interrogātīvō, quaestiō "sī/num" — hīc Graecum adhibet εἰ (litt. "sī", homographum condiciōnālis, sed fūnctiōne dīversā hīc).

rules.heading: a) Sequentia Prīmāria: Modus Retentus
rules.body: Post verbum rogandī PRAESĒNS/FUTŪRUM: modus quaestiōnis dīrēctae originālis manet (indicātīvus sī erat indicātīvus; coniūnctīvus dēlīberātīvus sī erat dēlīberātīvus): ἐρωτῶ τίς ἐστιν. "Rogō quis sit" (litt. "quis est", indicātīvus retentus, ā τίς ἐστιν; dīrēctā). ἐρωτῶ τί ποιῶμεν. "Rogō quid faciāmus" (dēlīberātīvus retentus).

rules.heading: b) Sequentia Secundāria: Optātīvus Oblīquus
rules.body: Post verbum rogandī PRAETERITUM: modus fit OPTĀTĪVUS, indepēndenter ā modō quaestiōnis dīrēctae originālis: ἠρώτησα τίς εἴη. "Rogāvī quis esset" (opt., ā τίς ἐστιν; indicātīvā orīgināliter). ἠρώτησεν εἰ ἔλθοι ὁ βασιλεύς. "Rogāvit num rēx vēnisset/venīret" (quaestiō "sī/num", ā εἰ + optātīvus).

rules.heading: c) Ὅστις: Interrogātīvum Oblīquum Alternātīvum
rules.body: ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅτι (litt. "quīcumque", compositum ex relātīvō ὅς + indēfīnītō τις, AMBABUS partibus dēclīnātīs: gen. οὗτινος, etc.) frequenter substituit τίς in interrogātiōnibus oblīquīs, praesertim apud auctōrēs Atticōs classicōs: οὐκ οἶδα ὅστις ἐστίν. "Nesciō quis sit." Nōtā: fōrma neutra ὅτι est identica scrīptūrā (sed dīversa accentū/contextū) coniūnctiōnī ὅτι "quod, quia" — cōnfūsiō possibilis, ēvītanda per contextum.

examples: ἐρωτῶ τίς ἐστιν. — Rogō quis sit. (prīmāria, indicātīvus retentus)
ἠρώτησα τίς εἴη. — Rogāvī quis esset. (secundāria, optātīvus oblīquus)
οὐκ οἶδα εἰ ἀληθές ἐστιν. — Nesciō num vērum sit. (εἰ, quaestiō "sī")
ἠπόρει ὅ τι ποιοῖ. — Dubitābat quid faceret. (secundāria, ὅτι neutrum interrogātīvum, nōn coniūnctiō)
ἐρωτῶσιν ὅστις ἦλθεν. — Rogant quis vēnerit. (ὅστις prō τίς, prīmāria)
οὐκ ᾔδειν εἰ σοφὸς εἴη ἢ μή. — Nesciēbam num sapiēns esset annōn. (εἰ...ἢ μή, alternātīva)

commonMistakes.wrong: Retinēre semper indicātīvum in interrogātiōne oblīquā, ignōrandō rēgulam sequentiae post verbum praeteritum.
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre optātīvum oblīquum post verbum rogandī SECUNDĀRIUM, exāctē sīcut in clausulīs fīnālibus/condiciōnālibus.
commonMistakes.why: Interrogātiō oblīqua sequitur eandem rēgulam sequentiae systēmaticam ac cēterae clausulae subōrdinātae.

commonMistakes.wrong: Adhibēre ἵνα vel ὅπως prō quaestiōne indirēctā "sī/num", cōnfundendō cum clausulā fīnālī.
commonMistakes.right: Adhibēre εἰ specificē prō quaestiōnibus sine verbō interrogātīvō explicitō ("num...").
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen syntacticum clārum: ἵνα/ὅπως intrōdūcunt propositum; εἰ intrōdūcit quaestiōnem indirēctam sine interrogātīvō.

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere ὅτι interrogātīvum (neutrum ὅστις, "quid") cum ὅτι coniūnctiōne ("quod, quia"), propter fōrmam scrīptūrae identicam.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere per contextum syntacticum: ὅ τι (duo verba, saepe scrīpta sēparātim) est interrogātīvum; ὅτι (ūnum verbum) est coniūnctiō.
commonMistakes.why: Ambiguitās orthographica reālis, resolvenda per convention scrīptūrae (spatium) et contextum.

items.explanation: Corrēctum: rēgula systēmatica trāns tōtam syntaxem clausulārum subōrdinātārum.

items.explanation: Corrēctum: patrōnus generālis sequentiae applicātur etiam hīc.

summary: Interrogātiō oblīqua sequitur rēgulam sequentiae: modus retentus (prīmāria) vs. optātīvus oblīquus (secundāria).
Εἰ intrōdūcit quaestiōnem indirēctam "sī/num", sine verbō interrogātīvō explicitō.
Ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅτι (= ὅς + τις, ambābus partibus dēclīnātīs) substituit frequenter τίς in interrogātiōne oblīquā.
Ὅ τι interrogātīvum ≠ ὅτι coniūnctiō ("quod, quia") — ambiguitās orthographica, resolvenda per contextum.
